Capture date: 2026-11-13 UTC (2026-11-12 Pacific). Native capture of duplicate search under private sharing and field access (plan 4b), Contact only, in Org D (same 30-day Developer Edition scratch org as ../q4b; deletion verified, see the last line).
Setup: Account, Contact, Lead, Case and Opportunity org-wide defaults Private by metadata (confirmed by EntityDefinition). Standard User "Sharing Reader" created with sf org create user (CLI-held auth; no password printed), with permission set ShareProbeUser (AuthorApex, ApiEnabled, ModifyMetadata, ViewRoles, ViewSetup as AuthorApex requires, plus class access). Public group ShareProbeGroup holds that user; criteria sharing rule ShareCrit (Contact Title equals crit, Read, to the group). Rules deployed one pass at a time: ShareEnforce and ShareBypass (exact Email, securityOption EnforceSharingRules or BypassSharingRules, insert action Allow with Alert), ShareEnforceHid and ShareBypassHid (exact Hid__c, same options); third pass the standard Contact rule (EnforceSharingRules) with the custom rules inactive. Hid__c is a custom field the user has no field-level access to.
Contacts without an Account are private contacts and cannot be shared. A first attempt used account-less seeds; manual and criteria sharing never revealed them (UserRecordAccess showed no read access despite ContactShare Manual and Rule rows). That attempt is superseded; every seed in the final data has an AccountId (admin-owned Account).
Routes: (1) anonymous as the admin; (2) anonuser: anonymous Apex run through the CLI authenticated as the standard user; (3) @IsTest with System.runAs(standard user). Routes 1 and 2 use committed fixtures created by one admin transaction (ShareBehavior.committedFixtures); route 3 creates its own fixtures in the test transaction (committed fixtures were absent for the test phase: tests ran first, fixtures were committed afterwards). Stale fixtures from earlier attempts were deleted and recreated once before the anonymous phase (verified counts). Each case records Find and Database.insert(false): rule, members returned, how many the running user can SOQL-read ("vis" labels by creation index, "hid" count of returned members the user cannot query), allowSave.
Fixtures: key 1 hidden (admin-owned seed, no share); 2 manual Read share to the user; 3 criteria share (Title crit); 4 three seeds, two admin-owned and one user-owned; 5 user-owned seed with Hid__c; 6 overflow: 120 seeds, first 60 admin-owned, last 60 user-owned. classSharing uses key 1 from with sharing, without sharing and inherited sharing classes. The helper labels readable seeds with an inner with-sharing class.
Frozen predictions: Glade 7b860d462 with GLADE_STANDARD_DUPLICATE_RULES=on, glade exec at API 67.0 on the same helper with sharing ignored (Glade has no sharing model), before each native run (frozen/predicted-Enforce.json, predicted-Bypass.json, predicted-Standard.json). Case adminBaseline repeats key 4 and in the test route runs as the user; the admin baseline is the anonymous route.
APIs 62.0 and 67.0, each run twice; helper and test classes redeployed per API and ApexClass.ApiVersion read back; the driver fails on Apex log truncation or exhaustion text, missing or incomplete frames, class API mismatch. matrix.txt lists the unique observation per case, route and API.
Caveats: committed seeds are indexed late (see the committed case in ../q1q3); in the committed overflow case the admin saw 89 of 120 matches and the user 29, so overflow-with-sharing is not settled. Criteria sharing recalculated in a test transaction did not reveal the seed (test route), but did on committed data. Some test-route cases differ between 62.0 and 67.0 (Bypass without-sharing class; field-hidden insert).
Final: d scratch deleted; active hub record 1 -> 0; local target no longer resolves
